description: This header defines various distribution functions for use with the Abseil C++ library's random number generator, including uniform, Bernoulli, Beta, Exponential, Gaussian, LogUniform, Poisson, and Zipf distributions.

methods.name: Uniform
methods.description: Template functions to generate uniformly distributed random values with various interval types and overloads.

methods.name: Bernoulli
methods.description: Function to generate a boolean value with probability p.

methods.name: Beta
methods.description: Function to generate a Beta-distributed floating point value.

methods.name: Exponential
methods.description: Function to generate an exponentially distributed floating point value.

methods.name: Gaussian
methods.description: Function to generate a normally distributed floating point value.

methods.name: LogUniform
methods.description: Function to generate a value with a log-uniform distribution over an interval.

methods.name: Poisson
methods.description: Function to generate a Poisson-distributed integer value.

methods.name: Zipf
methods.description: Function to generate a Zipf-distributed integer value.
